text:
brynn_support: FYI - Customer (acct_88Z) can't apply promo in Support Console. UI shows 'Action failed' toast and a 500. Tried twice from support UI.

mira_product: Which promo + amount? env? any request id?

brynn_support: Promo code TRIAL2025, $150 credits. Account acct_88Z. Steps: Support Console -> Accounts -> acct_88Z -> Credits -> Apply promo -> spinner -> error. No entry in admin logs for that action.

devon_eng: Can you paste the network / response body? Also tagging deploy-bot in case of recent admin-service deploys.

brynn_support: Response body: `{"error":"internal_server_error","message":"failed to materialize grant: write failure"}`. Header `x-request-id: req_0a1b2c`. Browser console shows 500 from POST /admin/grants.

samar_ops: I'm tailing backoffice logs for req_0a1b2c now. Quick glance shows `grant_service: write failed: write timeout` around the same time.

deploy-bot: deploy: admin-service v2025.03.12 rolled to prod by devon at 2025-03-12T08:34Z

devon_eng: I merged a small change this morning that touched the grant flow (optimistic ledger writes). Rolling the change back now.

brynn_support: Customer is in a sign-up flow, asking for ETA. Can we offer a manual credit as workaround?

mira_product: Manual credit is fine if ops does a ledger entry. Tag finance so they can reconcile. What's the safer idempotency key to avoid dupes?

samar_ops: Workaround: create a ledger row directly via internal API (ops-only):
```
curl -X POST https://backoffice.internal/api/ledgers \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"account_id":"acct_88Z","amount_cents":15000,"reason":"promo-manual-support","idempotency_key":"manual-req-4532"}'
```
Make sure to use a unique idempotency_key (manual-req-4532) and add comment referencing ticket #4532. Finance will reconcile against promo code later.

brynn_support: Running that now, will paste confirmation. Customer ok waiting 10-15 min.

samar_ops: Ledger entry created, response 201, ledger_id ldg_77f. I forwarded to finance.

devon_eng: Revert finished, admin-service back to v2025.03.11. Monitoring.

samar_ops: I'm replaying the original request against the reverted service for the req id: succeeded, write OK, no duplicate key. Looks like the new write path had a race.

mira_product: Please capture stack trace + minimal repro and put in #postmortems. Also check whether any promo code state got inconsistent.

brynn_support: Ticket updated: manual credit applied, customer confirmed receipt, promo application still fails in the console but backend is writable after rollback. Customer will wait for fix. :white_check_mark:

devon_eng: I'll open a short RFC for fixing the optimistic-write path and add tests for the idempotency layer.

samar_ops: Closing loop: finance acknowledged manual entry and will mark as promo-reconciled after fix.

brynn_support: Thanks all. Adding a quick note to the ticket and will follow up once dev fixes and we can re-enable the patch. :thumbsup:
